verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents creating and sending invoices, adjusting or refunding finalized invoices with credit notes, and downloading receipts. Invoices can be delivered automatically by charging the card on file or emailing the invoice, with automatic reminders, and Stripe Tax calculates VAT/GST/sales tax on invoices. missing for 10: no evidence of sequential invoice numbering, custom fields, or memos (rendering templates cover only appearance), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
